mentions.name: Overcentric
mentions.description: All-in-one growth toolkit for startups that combines traffic and user acquisition analytics, product usage insight, friction and issue spotting, and customer support in a single cohesive package. It is designed to be simple to integrate and use, replacing several disconnected tools, with plans for deeper AI integrations and automations so the tools work together automatically with a few lines of code.
mentions.problem: Startups juggle several disconnected tools to understand traffic, product usage, friction and to support customers.
mentions.audience: Startups and early-stage companies (currently being shaped with a group of companies in early access)
mentions.source_excerpt: Overcentric makes it easier to understand traffic and user acquisition, product usage, spot friction and issues and provide customer support - all in one place.

evidence.value: Overcentric makes it easier to understand traffic and user acquisition, product usage, spot friction and issues and provide customer support - all in one place.
evidence.author: harundu

mentions.name: Overcentric
mentions.description: This toolkit combines web & product analytics, chat support, a help center, session replays, and frontend error reporting into one simple, affordable platform for startups. Planned features include more startup-focused tools, expanded LLM usage (support, session replay summaries, help center article writing, integrations), and refined pricing.
mentions.problem: Startups otherwise need to piece together and pay for multiple separate tools for analytics, support, help center, session replays, and error reporting; Overcentric offers them combined in one affordable place.
mentions.audience: Startups, including the startups that have integrated it and use it for analytics, support, and error reporting
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Overcentric - a simple and affordable toolkit that combines web & product analytics, chat support, help center, session replays and frontend error reporting, all in one place.

evidence.value: I am building Overcentric - a simple and affordable toolkit that combines web & product analytics, chat support, help center, session replays and frontend error reporting, all in one place.
